notes.title: Frustrate-a-ball now has Steam Achievements
notes.notes:
The latest version of Frustrate-a-ball has now been released and includes Steam Achievements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35679727/e50064fc03b9fc619946dd37c6cc9b559c1332ed.png[/img]

There's simple score based achievements, level achievements, shoot the skull achievements and many, many more. They'll have you coming back for just [b]one more go[/b] as you try and complete them all.

This new version also includes patterned backgrounds and some new visual effects.

-enjoy!

notes.title: Frustrate-a-ball v1.3 released
notes.notes:
[b]v1.3 Released[/b]

So, whats new in version 1.3 of Frustrate-a-ball:

- New BRK Power-Up. Collect this and a line of bricks forms on the screen. Great to keep the ball near the top of the screen.
- New visual effects for menus, in-game effects and HUD.
- Some small bug fixes.

Enjoy!!
